name: oracle-diagnostic
lessons: Every turn, use troops and then recruit in every offered city you can afford; keep less than $200 unspent.
Every turn, move an army into every adjacent city that is empty or neutral.
Every turn, attack adjacent enemy cities with your larger armies, even at modest odds: a lost battle costs little, a captured city counts.
Drill only an army that has nothing else useful to do this turn.
Keep one army in Washington; every other army advances.
Every turn, use rail to bring a rested army to the front.
Every turn, give the fleet an order: attack the enemy port it is in, sail to one, or raid.
On the alternate map you win at 60% of total income: take cities fast. On the standard map, take cities and survive to 1865.
